The '''Gorothites''' were [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Sentience/Legends|sentients]] indigenous to [[Goroth Prime/Legends|Goroth Prime]]. In their own language they were called "'''B'Dellyi''' (sing. B'Del)," which meant "the People."

==Appearance and biology==
Gorothites were reptilian in appearance with sloping foreheads and a skull that bulged out at the back of their heads. They had several flaps of loose skin under the chin that could be expanded by contracting muscles in their neck. Their small eyes were under a bony ridges that protected them from bright lights. The species had no external ears but did have three [[Centimeter/Legends|centimeter]] eardrums located flush on the side of their heads. This provided them with excellent hearing but made them susceptible to loud sudden noises.<ref name="AE" />

They communicated by creating resonances in their sinus cavities. Gorothite skin was knobby in appearance but supple to the touch. They had long, muscular arms that had two double-jointed elbows and ended with hands containing five double-jointed fingers.<ref name="AE" />

==Society and culture==
Gorothites were not monogamous and interbred with other members of their [[j'ber]] only. The species was by nature a thoughtful people and would take a long time to ponder a decision before proceeding.<ref name="AE" />

Central to Gorothite society was the j'ber, a family unit or group of individuals connected by bonds of blood and honor. The known j'bers to exist were:
*[[J'ber B'Yen]] was formerly numerous, but by the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] the last survivor was [[B'Yen Do V'nel]], the leader of the resistance group [[K'Len J'Bar Kasoon]].
*[[J'ber D'Reb]] was reputed to be the best equipped to handle the task of transporting cargo between cities.
*[[J'ber D'Trel]] was dominant in the [[o'beki]] of [[Graith]] and eventually emerged as the dominant j'ber on Goroth Prime, becoming the effective planetary government.<ref name="AE" />
*[[J'ber J'Kek]] was an influential clan on Goroth Prime before [[Se'Lenti|the Scouring]] that specialized in politics. The j'ber was wiped out during the Scouring.
*[[J'ber Jer'N]] in the years following the Scouring, emerged as the premier weaponsmiths on Goroth Prime with their company, [[Jer'N Weapons Systems]].
*[[J'ber P'Tel]] was dominant in food production.
*[[J'ber V'Jar]] created Goroth Prime's premier vehicle company, [[V'Jar Technologies]].
*[[J'ber V'Sook]] was a small Gorothite j'ber that, in the wake of the Scouring, created a religious philosophy known as [[M'Nes]], or the "True Faith." The religion was first preached by [[V'Sook M'Alra Vin]], and spread across Goroth Prime over the centuries.

==History==
During the [[Corellian/Aqualish war]] [[4000 BBY/Legends|c.4000 BBY]], the struggle between the [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] and [[Corellian/Legends|Corellians]] fought for control of Goroth Prime's mining resources. The desolation brought about on the planet became known as the [[Se'Lenti]], translated from Gorothite into Basic as "the Scouring," when asteroids were deliberately crashed into the planet, killing some five billion Gorothites and releasing vaporized [[Hyperbaride/Legends|hyperbaride]] from the crust into the [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]].

In [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]] the Gorothites were enslaved by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] under the control of [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Marsh Limoth]] and [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Nebin Cray]]. The [[J'Mer Sab|Night Wind]] resistance movement arose in response. The Gorothite were eventually freed by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] shortly after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].
